final.background: Core inflation measures the rise in consumer prices while excluding volatile categories such as food and energy. Stripping out these unpredictable price swings provides a clearer view of underlying, longer-term price trends. It helps central banks and economists evaluate broader economic health.
final.author_says: Core inflation, which excludes food and fuel, stayed at 4.2% for a third month, and analysts said that underlying price pressures remain contained.

draft.background: Core inflation measures the change in prices across an economy while leaving out volatile categories like food and energy. Tracking it helps policymakers and economists see the underlying, longer-term trend in price changes without short-term price spikes clouding the view.
draft.author_says: Core inflation, which leaves out food and fuel prices, remained at 4.2% for a third straight month.
